document.description: Exactly one of bytes_base64 | url | path | file_id must be set.

bytes_base64.description: Inline document bytes. Router MAY spool to a temp file / upload to backend-required storage (e.g. Textract S3, LlamaParse /files).

url.description: Fetchable URL. Some backends accept URLs directly (Docling convert(url), reducto); others require the router to download first.

path.description: Local filesystem path. Only valid for in-process/subprocess/container backends (oss_library, framework_loader, self_hosted_model).

file_id.description: Opaque id of a previously uploaded file (LlamaParse file_id, OpenAI file id, reused Chunkr parse task id).

password.description: For encrypted PDFs (pikepdf/pypdf can open; most OCR backends cannot).

backend.description: Which backend to run, and how it is provisioned. Encodes the four BYO modes.

id.description: Slug from the backend registry, e.g. 'aws-textract', 'docling', 'pymupdf', 'langchain-pdf-loaders:PyMuPDFLoader'.

operation.description: Sub-operation when a backend has several. Textract: DetectDocumentText|AnalyzeDocument|AnalyzeExpense|AnalyzeID|AnalyzeLending. Docling: default|vlm. LlamaParse tier: fast|cost_effective|agentic|agentic_plus.

version.description: Pin the backend/model version (LlamaParse 'version', model weights tag, library version).

credentials_ref.description: BYO-KEY (hosted_api): reference into the caller's secret store (AWS role ARN, 'llx-...' key handle). Never the raw secret in the request body.

endpoint.description: For self_hosted_model served via an OpenAI-compatible or custom endpoint (vLLM, docling-serve, TGI).

system_deps_ok.description: Caller asserts poppler/tesseract/ghostscript/CUDA are present (see routing memo). Router MAY still probe.

outputs.description: Desired output channels. The adapter fills what the backend supports and reports the rest in response.warnings.

blocks.description: Reading-order typed blocks with optional bbox/confidence (the common spine). Impossible for pure typed-field APIs and un-prompted token-stream LLMs.

include_backend_raw.description: Return the untouched native payload / serialized native object (see §5). Off by default for high-volume callers who only want normalized.

extraction_schema.description: Custom typed extraction (P2/P6). A JSON Schema describing the fields to pull. Routed to /extract (Reducto, Chunkr), documents[].fields via queryFields (Azure), QUERIES (Textract, degraded), Structured Outputs (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude), document_annotation (Mistral). Backends that cannot do schema extraction return a warning.

instructions.description: System prompt / extraction guidance for LLM-based extractors.

citations.description: Request per-field source grounding (page + bbox) where supported (Reducto, Chunkr, Claude page citations).

features.description: Capability flags. Adapter maps to native toggles; unsupported flags → response.warnings, never a hard error.

ocr.description: off = born-digital only (Docling do_ocr=False, pypdf/pymupdf). force = always rasterize+OCR.

ocr_languages.description: ISO codes; e.g. ['en'] Tesseract, Textract 6 Latin only.

pages.description: Page selection. Normalizer applies 1-based inclusive ranges before/after backend call depending on whether the backend supports native page ranges.

routing.description: Hints for the router when backend.id is a class rather than a concrete backend, or for fallback.

fallback.description: Ordered backend ids to try if the primary fails or violates a compliance constraint.

compliance.description: Hard constraints the router enforces at dispatch. A backend that cannot meet these is not eligible (and is skipped in fallback).

require_baa.description: HIPAA: only backends that advertise a BAA (or fully-local backends where PHI never leaves) are eligible. The gate reads what each vendor publishes about its own BAA, so passing it is necessary and not sufficient; the agreement your organisation actually signed is yours to confirm out of band.

no_train_on_data.description: Excludes backends that train on inputs without opt-out (e.g. Textract trains by default; opt-out required).

data_region.description: e.g. 'us', 'eu'. Enforced against backend data-region options.

require_local.description: Only oss_library / self_hosted_model / on-prem: data never leaves the caller's environment.

mode.description: auto: router picks sync/async per backend + doc size (Textract forces async for multi-page PDFs; LlamaParse is async-only).

idempotency_key.description: Dedup; maps to Textract ClientRequestToken, etc.
